pages.title: A Walrus Signal
pages.text: The shell connects a signal to a particular pet.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tame walrus through riding; it has a land slam and underwater whirlwind. Use Conch on a pet to bind it; walrus shell-playing is a separate native interaction. A bound shell must contain a real target.
